name: my-project
//feedbackFile: Where new work lands (one JSON object per line). Point your app/⌘-shortcut here, or use `listen feedback "..."`. Path is relative to .listen/.
//stateDir: Where item dossiers live (one folder per work item). Relative to .listen/. Use an absolute or ~ path to share across worktrees.
//agent: The agent each stage runs, headless and once per item. {PROMPT} is substituted if present, else the stage prompt is appended. Swap cmd/args to use a different agent CLI.
//statuses: The status flow. New items start at the first status. Each stage moves an item from its inbox status to the next. Reorder / rename / add / remove to fit your project.
//stages: One agent per stage. `batch:true` reads the feedback file instead of items (triage). `inbox` is the status whose items this stage processes. `requiresFile` (optional) only dispatches an item once that artifact exists in its dossier (e.g. wait for user answers).
